transformer.name: avro-x-java-object
transformer.title: Avro X Java Object
transformer.description: Transforms from JSon to Java object using Jackson Avro (supports content schema)

transformerIn.description: Json text or a JsonNode, or Avro binary with the Avro schema in the X-Content-Schema exchange property, read into the class of the X-Content-Class exchange property, which a body other than a POJO needs: a POJO of that class, or any POJO without it, is kept, and so is a Map or a List without it; a Map or a List with it, and a null body, fail

transformerOut.description: An object of the class of the X-Content-Class exchange property, or the POJO, Map or List as it was without it
